stories.headline: Trump's envoys meet Putin after Ukraine talks
body: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin.
They had just brokered two days of Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi.
Washington wants new momentum towards ending the war.
stories.joke: Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, Moscow on Thursday: diplomacy's frequent-flyer season.
stories.vc: A ceasefire path would lower energy prices and open Ukraine's rebuilding market.

stories.headline: Israeli strike on Gaza's Nasser Hospital kills six
body: An Israeli airstrike hit Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza, killing six people including a surgeon and a 13-year-old boy.
Israel says it targeted a Hamas commander, who was not among the dead.
The strike hit the hospital's surgical wing.
stories.vc: Attacks on hospitals deepen Gaza's health crisis and raise reconstruction costs.

stories.headline: Migrant caravan heads for US; Trump threatens Mexico with tariffs
body: A migrant caravan has set out from southern Mexico towards the US.
Many migrants say the Democrats' midterm wins gave them new hope.
Trump says Mexico must stop the caravans or face doubled tariffs.
stories.vc: Tariff threats on Mexico could disrupt North American supply chains.

stories.headline: India's inflation crosses RBI's 6% limit for the first time in two years
body: Retail inflation rose to 6.1% in October, above the RBI's upper limit of 6%.
Food and fuel led, but price rises have spread to nearly all sectors.
It's the highest since October 2024.
stories.vc: Higher inflation makes RBI rate cuts unlikely and squeezes household budgets.

stories.headline: Chennai's A2B gets $180M from Murdoch and Shankar's Bodhi Tree
body: Food chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B) has sold a majority stake to Bodhi Tree Systems for $180 million.
Bodhi Tree was co-founded by James Murdoch and Uday Shankar.
The deal reportedly values the 50-year-old brand at about $350 million.
stories.joke: Sweets and savouries, now with global media money.
stories.vc: Big investors backing Indian restaurant chains signals faith in branded food expansion.

stories.headline: 22 companies bid to build India's battery cell factories
body: The Centre received 22 bids for 10 GWh of giga-scale battery cell manufacturing under its incentive scheme.
Bidders include Reliance, Amara Raja, Exide and Vikram Solar.
The aim is to make India self-reliant in batteries.
stories.joke: Everyone wants to charge India's batteries.
stories.vc: Strong demand means more domestic cells for EVs and grid storage soon.

stories.statLabel: Nvidia's share of AI chip market
stories.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; Colette Kress steps in
body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned after revelations of extramarital affairs and possible spying concerns.
Chief financial officer Colette Kress is now interim CEO.
Nvidia controls about 90% of the market for advanced AI chips.
stories.vc: Leadership uncertainty at the AI industry's key supplier adds risk for chip stocks worldwide.

stories.headline: Trump floats Tim Cook as Nvidia's next CEO
body: Trump says Apple chairman Tim Cook is the only one who could replace Jensen Huang.
Cook stepped down as Apple CEO on 1 September but is still executive chairman.
Nvidia has not named a permanent CEO.
stories.joke: Job ad: must know chips, China and how to handle Truth Social posts.
stories.vc: Who leads Nvidia next will shape investor confidence in the whole AI trade.

stories.headline: SoftBank's turbine over-order hits AI's gas power plans
body: SoftBank reportedly put deposits on over 13 gigawatts of gas turbines, almost 50% more than it needed.
That has led to a billion-dollar loss, TechCrunch reports.
It may cap the rush to power AI with natural gas.
stories.joke: Buying turbines like it's Black Friday.
stories.vc: Losses like this could make AI firms rethink building their own power plants.

stories.headline: Nebius plans $40B of spending, far above expectations
body: AI cloud firm Nebius plans to spend $40 billion in 2027.
It will fund it with customer prepayments and loans backed by contracts.
Its CEO admits delays are common in the industry.
stories.joke: Spend now, prepay later, hope nobody cancels.
stories.vc: Debt-funded AI data centres are a growing risk if demand slows.

stories.headline: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights
body: United Airlines will restrict AI agents that book flights for users.
It cites cybersecurity risks from sharing logins with AI assistants.
Other big firms have taken similar steps.
stories.joke: Your AI assistant will have to queue like everyone else.
stories.vc: Pushback from big companies could slow the business case for AI shopping agents.

stories.headline: Kansas will have two women governors back-to-back
body: Democrat Cindy Holscher is projected to become governor of Kansas.
She will follow Laura Kelly, making it the first time the state has two women governors in a row.
The race was very close and called only on Thursday.
stories.vc: Holscher ran on lower costs, putting household budgets at the centre of state policy.

stories.headline: Texas Democrats see a chance to roll back the abortion ban
body: Texas Democrats now control the state House and plan to push to repeal the near-total abortion ban.
The ban has been linked to the deaths of several women.
Republicans still control the state Senate.
stories.vc: Abortion rules affect where women choose to live and work, a factor for employers.

stories.headline: Women voters outnumber men by 55,437 in Manipur
body: Manipur's draft voter rolls show 10.25 lakh women and 9.69 lakh men.
That's 1,057 women for every 1,000 men.
Assembly elections are due by March 2027.
stories.vc: Women voters' weight could push parties to focus on safety, jobs and relief in the conflict-hit state.

stories.headline: Bengaluru oncologist, 60+, opens his own cancer hospital
body: Oncologist Radheshyam Naik has set up the 40-bed Samprada Hospital in J.P. Nagar, Bengaluru.
He started it after 60, using much of his savings.
It focuses on cancer prevention, treatment and family support, after he lost both parents to cancer.
stories.vc: Small specialist hospitals founded by doctors are a growing part of Bengaluru's health market.

stories.headline: Tamil Nadu CM to open ₹134 crore, 600-bed hospital block in Tiruchy
body: Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay will open a new multi-storey specialty block in Tiruchy on 20 November.
It cost ₹134 crore and has 600 beds.
It adds major capacity to the region's public health care.
stories.vc: Large public blocks in tier-2 cities reduce pressure on Chennai's hospitals.

stories.statLabel: hospitals may owe free EWS care
stories.headline: 107 Delhi hospitals may have to treat poor patients free
body: Delhi told the Supreme Court that 107 hospitals may have to give free treatment to economically weaker patients.
That's more than double the 51 already under scrutiny.
Hospitals given cheap land must reserve 10% of beds for such patients.
stories.vc: Enforcing free-bed rules could cost private hospitals revenue but widen access for the poor.

stories.headline: Lawson keeps his Racing Bulls seat for 2027
body: Racing Bulls kept Liam Lawson for 2027, alongside Arvid Lindblad.
Lawson has 89 points to Lindblad's 38, helping the team to fifth, its best-ever result.
Junior Nikola Tsolov becomes reserve driver instead.
stories.vc: A best-ever team finish means more prize money for Racing Bulls.
